definitions.short: Kenath , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H7079. Qenath קְנָת proper name, of a location κααθ , Κα ( α ) ναθ E of Jordan Num 32:42 (JE) 1Chr 2:23 ; perhaps †anawat on western slope of Hauran mountains (Buhl Geogr.252 ). קסם (√ of following; apparently originally divide, assign (deity), Arabic , divide, distribute, x. get a part allotted to oneself , especially by drawing lots [with headless arrows] at sanctuary (compare especially Ezek 21:26 ; 21:27 ; IV. swear ; see also Ethiopic : IV. use divination , so קְסַם ᵑ7 Syriac ; קִיסְמָא divination ; see especially RS JPhil. xiii (1885), 276 ff, We Skizzen iii, 127 f. 167; Heid. 2.132 ff. Dr Deut 18:10 )

occurrences.englishText: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
